entries.title: Psalms 80:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. Set to "The Lillies." A Testimony of Asaph. A Psalm.>> Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, You who lead Joseph like a flock; You who dwell [between] the cherubim, shine forth!

entries.title: Psalms 80:2
segments: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, Stir up Your strength, And come [and] save us!

entries.title: Psalms 80:3
segments: Restore us, O God; Cause Your face to shine, And we shall be saved!

entries.title: Psalms 80:4
segments: O LORD God of hosts, How long will You be angry Against the prayer of Your people?

entries.title: Psalms 80:5
segments: You have fed them with the bread of tears, And given them tears to drink in great measure.

entries.title: Psalms 80:6
segments: You have made us a strife to our neighbors, And our enemies laugh among themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 80:7
segments: Restore us, O God of hosts; Cause Your face to shine, And we shall be saved!

entries.title: Psalms 80:8
segments: ¶You have brought a vine out of Egypt; You have cast out the nations, and planted it.

entries.title: Psalms 80:9
segments: You prepared [room] for it, And caused it to take deep root, And it filled the land.

entries.title: Psalms 80:10
segments: The hills were covered with its shadow, And the mighty cedars with its boughs.

entries.title: Psalms 80:11
segments: She sent out her boughs to the Sea, And her branches to the River.

entries.title: Psalms 80:12
segments: Why have You broken down her hedges, So that all who pass by the way pluck her [fruit]?

entries.title: Psalms 80:13
segments: The boar out of the woods uproots it, And the wild beast of the field devours it.

entries.title: Psalms 80:14
segments: Return, we beseech You, O God of hosts; Look down from heaven and see, And visit this vine

entries.title: Psalms 80:15
segments: And the vineyard which Your right hand has planted, And the branch [that] You made strong for Yourself.

entries.title: Psalms 80:16
segments: [It is] burned with fire, [it is] cut down; They perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 80:17
segments: Let Your hand be upon the man of Your right hand, Upon the son of man [whom] You made strong for Yourself.

entries.title: Psalms 80:18
segments: Then we will not turn back from You; Revive us, and we will call upon Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 80:19
segments: Restore us, O LORD God of hosts; Cause Your face to shine, And we shall be saved!
